title: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Micronesia: 5-Step Official Checklist
titleEn: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Micronesia: 5-Step Official Checklist
cardSummary: Official 5-step serious and terminal illness checklist for Micronesia: palliative care coordination, advance directives, powers of attorney, disability and caregiver support, and estate preparation.
introHtml: Organizing healthcare, workplace, estate, social security, and civil identity records in advance in the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM) requires coordinating both federal rules and state-level courts in Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei, or Yap [1][4][9]. Because probate statutes, vital registries, and hospital operations sit primarily at the state level rather than inside one national online portal, early preparation reduces administrative friction across islands [1][4][9].

steps.title: State hospital coordination, off-island referrals, and statutory leave
steps.html:
• Coordinate clinical care, specialist planning, and medical referrals through the relevant public hospital recognized by the FSM Department of Health and Social Affairs (hsa.gov.fm): Chuuk State Hospital (+691 330-2217), Kosrae State Hospital (+691 370-3012), Pohnpei State Hospital (+691 320-2213 / 3805), or Yap State Hospital (+691 350-2110 / 3446) [1][10][12].
  • Confirm off-island referral insurance rules and care-companion documentation early if treatment in Guam, Hawaii, or the Philippines is possible [10].
  • For FSM National Government civil servants, check Title 52 and the FSM Public Service System Regulations: eligible employees accrue 4 hours of sick leave per pay period with no total accumulation cap, and absences exceeding 3 consecutive days require qualified medical certification [3][13]. Check state public-service rules or private employment contracts for state and private workers [13].

steps.title: State Wills, Powers of Attorney, and guardianship planning
steps.html:
• Draft or update a written Will under the applicable state code where assets and land sit, such as Title 49 (Wills and Decedents' Estates) in the Pohnpei State Code, because intestacy, real-property rules, and custom vary across the four states [4].
  • Clarify proxy documents early: because the FSM lacks a single nationwide advance-directive statute, families routinely prepare written Powers of Attorney or standby minor guardianship documents with legal counsel or Micronesian Legal Services Corporation (MLSC) when travel, hospitalization, or off-island referrals are anticipated [11].
  • Verify local customary and statutory restrictions on land ownership transfers before signing any estate transfer clauses [4][11].

steps.title: FSM Social Security Administration (FSMSSA) records and benefit checks
steps.html:
• Confirm earnings quarters, insured status, and family member records directly with FSM Social Security Administration (FSMSSA) at its Kolonia headquarters (+691 320-2706 / 2708 / 4407) or branch offices in Chuuk (+691 330-2200), Kosrae (+691 370-3048), Pohnpei (+691 320-2709 / 2181), or Yap (+691 350-2309 / 8489) [7][8].
  • Review official forms and survivor vs. lump-sum eligibility rules in advance so dependants understand whether monthly survivor benefits apply or whether the 4% cumulative covered-earnings lump-sum priority hierarchy applies [5][6][8].
  • Check retirement or disability benefit criteria if permanent incapacity prevents work, keeping employer payroll records and FSM Social Security numbers well documented [5][7][8].

steps.title: Vital civil certificates, tax status, and original document custody
steps.html:
• Obtain clean certified copies of birth and marriage certificates early through FSM State Supreme Court Clerks (US$ 2 to US$ 3 per copy depending on the state): Chuuk (691) 330-2228 / 2717, Kosrae (691) 370-3033, Pohnpei (691) 320-2355 / 5667, and Yap (691) 350-2161 / 2162 [9]. Resolve spelling discrepancies across state records, passports, and FSMSSA files promptly [7][9].
  • Confirm wage, salary, and gross revenue tax compliance under Title 54 of the FSM Code, noting that national FSM tax law imposes wage/salary and business revenue taxes without a federal inheritance or estate tax [2].
  • Store original signed Wills, Powers of Attorney, bank records, land deeds, and vital certificates in an accessible, dry, fire-safe folder known to trusted family members [4][9][11].

steps.title: Consular legalisation readiness and cross-border inventory
steps.html:
• Check authentication rules early if family members, pensions, or accounts are in the United States, Guam, or another country: because the FSM is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, FSM public documents used abroad require consular or diplomatic legalisation rather than an Apostille [14].
  • Compile a structured written inventory listing FSMSSA numbers, state court clerk file details, domestic and overseas bank accounts, insurance policies, employer contacts, and safe-custody locations [7][8][9].
  • Verify hospital, airline, and FSM Embassy consular rules early if repatriation or overseas care travel could arise [10][12].

prefillQuestion: A family member is facing a serious or terminal illness in the Federated States of Micronesia. We need an overview of the main official steps and contacts in the Federated States of Micronesia for palliative care, powers of attorney, advance directives, and caregiver support.

contacts.name: FSM Department of Health and Social Affairs
contacts.note: National health department; coordinates with State Hospitals in Chuuk (+691 330-2217), Kosrae (+691 370-3012), Pohnpei (+691 320-2213), and Yap (+691 350-2110).

contacts.name: FSM Social Security Administration (FSMSSA)
contacts.note: Headquarters in Kolonia (+691 320-2706/2708/4407) plus Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei, and Yap branch offices for member earnings records and benefit forms.

contacts.name: FSM State Supreme Court Clerks
contacts.note: State Supreme Court offices maintaining and certifying state vital records across Pohnpei, Chuuk, Kosrae, and Yap.

contacts.name: Micronesian Legal Services Corporation (MLSC)
contacts.note: Legal aid service assisting eligible FSM residents with Powers of Attorney, minor guardianship, and estate planning documents.
